policy: Install once, route narrowly. Bundled capability availability does not imply automatic activation or stronger evidence.
activation_contract: CS Navigator activates on capability-selection intent, not task subject matter alone.
Bundled skills remain independently evidenced and versioned.
A matching bundled skill is not necessary when ChatGPT can handle the direct task natively.
Do not assume skill-to-skill handoff; recommend the capability and keep the next action explicit when needed.
